forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: A cycle means two modules are one module; merge them or extract the shared part. Hey API's generated runtime has type-only cycles we do not own.

forbidden.name: no-orphans
forbidden.comment: A module nothing imports is dead code. Entry points, tests and declarations are exempt.

forbidden.name: lib-is-not-a-command
forbidden.comment: tools/lib holds the logic; commands are thin citty wrappers over it, never the other way round.

forbidden.name: commands-are-leaves
forbidden.comment: One command never imports another; shared behaviour moves to tools/lib.

forbidden.name: production-never-imports-tests
forbidden.comment: Fixtures and test helpers stay in tools/tests.

forbidden.name: generated-clients-behind-capture
forbidden.comment: Only capture/sources.ts and capture/clients.ts talk to the generated HTTP clients; everything else uses their typed results.

forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable
forbidden.comment: Every import must resolve; a typo here is a runtime crash.

forbidden.name: no-non-package-json
forbidden.comment: Packages must be declared in package.json, not borrowed from a transitive dependency.
